capital.evidence_quote: Dushanbe is the capital and largest urban metropolis of the Republic of Tajikistan

currency.evidence_quote: The Tajikistani Somoni (TJS, сом) is the official currency; trades around 10.9 TJS to 1 USD

timezone.evidence_quote: Tajikistan Time operates year-round on UTC+5 with no daylight saving adjustments

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard residential supply voltage across Tajikistan is 220V 50 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: Operating frequency of the national electrical grid is 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: European standard Type C round two-pin and Schuko Type F sockets are standard

sources.title: Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Republic of Tajikistan

police.evidence_quote: Dial 102 for emergency police response throughout Tajikistan

sources.title: Ministry of Health and Social Protection Tajikistan

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 103 for emergency medical services and ambulance dispatch

sources.title: Committee on Emergency Situations and Civil Defence (CoES)

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 101 for emergency fire and rescue services

general.evidence_quote: 112 is the unified national emergency dispatch contact number

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Tourist Police department under the Ministry of Internal Affairs operates at +992 37 221-1212

advisory_headline.tr: Tacikistan son derece huzurlu ve büyüleyici bir dağ ülkesidir; Afganistan sınır hattında standart dikkat gereklidir.
advisory_headline.en: Tajikistan is very peaceful and scenic; exercise normal precautions, with vigilance along the Afghan border.
advisory_headline.de: Tadschikistan ist ein friedliches Gebirgsland; normale Vorsichtsmaßnahmen, erhöht entlang der Grenze zu Afghanistan.
advisory_headline.ru: Таджикистан в целом безопасен и дружелюбен; проявляйте осторожность в приграничной полосе с Афганистаном.
advisory_headline.es: Tayikistán es un país montañoso pacífico; aplican precauciones normales con cautela en la frontera afgana.

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Tajikistan reach approximately 20.0 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds in Dushanbe measure 36.0 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: Tcell, MegaFon Tajikistan, and Babilon-M provide 4G SIM cards in Dushanbe (DYU airport). Stays exceeding 10 business days require official OVIR police registration. Pamir Highway expeditions require a separate GBAO permit.
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: Foreigners staying over 10 working days must register with the migration authority (OVIR)

religion.value: Islam (approx. 96%, predominantly Sunni Hanafi approx. 90% and Ismaili Shia approx. 5% in the Pamirs)

sources.title: Agency on Statistics under the President of the Republic of Tajikistan

religion.evidence_quote: Sunni traditions dominate western valleys; Pamiri communities in Badakhshan practice Ismaili Islam

festivals.value: Navruz (Persian New Year on March 21-24), Mehrgon autumn harvest, Roof of the World Cultural Festival in Khorog, Eid festivals
festivals.evidence_quote: Navruz is the most grand annual holiday celebrated with sumanak wheat pudding and buzkashi horse games

legal_cultural_warnings.value: A special GBAO (Gorno-Badakhshan Autonomous Oblast) permit is legally required to travel the Pamir Highway; obtain it during e-Visa application or at OVIR in Dushanbe. Foreigners staying over 10 working days must register with migration police. Modest dress is standard.
legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: Travel into the GBAO border territory requires an official electronic or endorsed permit

tipping.value: A 10-15% service charge is usually included on restaurant bills in Dushanbe. Tipping Pamir Highway 4x4 drivers and homestay hosts ($10-15 per day) is customary.
tipping.evidence_quote: A 10% service fee is included on restaurant bills; tipping mountain expedition drivers is standard
